sample.text: We deliver world-class video solutions that elevate your brand. Our passionate team crafts stories that resonate. Contact us today.

evidence.why: Category filler that any studio could claim.
The only call to action is company-centric.
A claim with no example, number or method beside it.
The site's plain, short lines give way to adjectives.
Describes the studio, not what the buyer gets.

top_gaps.fix: Open with what the buyer gets.
